history.prompt:
Create an original publication-quality technical explanatory illustration as a no-text PNG. The supplied external images are mechanism references only: independently design a fresh composition, never imitate their layout or typography. Use a pure white canvas (transparent is acceptable only if it composites as pure white), thin muted graphite flow arrows, flat 2D orthographic shapes, smooth solid pale fills. Palette: cyan input (#4DBBD5), green processing (#00A087), warm orange pooling (#F39B7F), muted blue representations (#3C5488), red output/gradients (#E64B35), neutral gray supporting parts. Colors at low opacity for large areas, stronger outlines and small accents. Balance white modules with selectively pale colored groups, one dominant color per semantic group. Same semantic modules share treatment; adjacent unlike semantics have different color. No glossy icon tiles, no card dashboard, no thick title bars, no decorative 3D, no perspective side faces, no extruded tensors, no shadow, glow, blur, gradient, texture, paper grain, noise, ripple, stripe or watermark. Mechanism marks (flat grids, feature-map thumbnails, small nodes, pooling cells) must carry scientific information rather than decorative icons. Optional decorative icons at most one per group; preferably none for operator diagrams. Avoid excessive boxes around everything. Reserve generous blank title and adjacent numeric annotation areas for later real-font typesetting. ABSOLUTELY NO readable text, letters, digits, equations, operation symbols, pseudo-glyphs, placeholder scribbles or watermark. All labels and math will be added later. A handwritten specimen inside an input image is an allowed visual sample, not a printed label. Arrowheads are required at actual destinations, no disconnected stubs or unexplained edges.

Scientific brief:
Explain transformed-domain convolution in a clear shared pipeline: input tile and filter separately enter their transforms; transformed input and transformed kernel meet at a local elementwise multiplication stage that also sums input channels; the result enters output inverse transform and becomes an output tile. Use actual flat grids and no decorative gear icons. Below the shared pipeline show THREE distinct parallel algorithm mechanism miniatures, with blank headings: polynomial evaluation then interpolation for Toom-Cook (full polynomial product), tiny fixed-matrix transform and small output block for Winograd (minimal local filtering), padded input waveform and frequency-domain samples then inverse for FFT (linear convolution avoids wraparound). A workflow with meaningful grids and local products, no missing input-channel reduction. Do not visually claim the three transforms are identical or confuse convolution with transposed convolution. All text, operators, equations will be added later; leave central operation blank and one full-width formula/annotation lane below.

source_audit.caption: 变换类卷积的共同流程与不同目标。Toom--Cook通过多项式求值及插值恢复完整乘积系数；Winograd通过固定小矩阵恢复所需输出块；FFT在补零后的频域相乘并反变换。输入和核可以分别变换，变换结果按输入通道相乘并求和；能复用多少次，决定变换开销能否被摊薄。
source_audit.label: fig:cnn-transform-algorithms
source_audit.title: 变换卷积的共同步骤与各自目标
source_audit.reason: 多阶段机制、并行/反馈路径、密集层次或多任务架构，超出少量节点/规则格表的简单图
source_audit.mechanism_brief: 输入与核各自变换→按输入通道逐位置/频点乘并求和→输出变换。三条实例：Toom–Cook为多项式求值/插值完整乘积，Winograd为固定小矩阵恢复所需块，FFT先补零频域乘后逆变换以避免循环混叠。
must_preserve: 三者不是同一变换矩阵
补零满足线性卷积长度，Winograd不声称总成本只数核心乘法。
source_audit.layout_instruction: 模型自主构图，只使用本简报中的事实与新选外部同主题参考；禁止任何本项目旧图、旧预览、裁图作为图像输入。
